definitions.explanation: A pre-arranged meeting or appointment, especially in business contexts. Abbreviated from アポイントメント (appointment).

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}、{午後|ごご}3{時|じ}にアポを{入|い}れてあります。
examples.english: I have an appointment scheduled for 3 PM tomorrow.

examples.japanese: アポなしで{訪問|ほうもん}するのは{失礼|しつれい}だ。
examples.english: It's rude to visit without an appointment.

examples.japanese: {新規|しんき}のお{客様|きゃくさま}からアポが{取|と}れた。
examples.english: I got an appointment with a new client.

notes:
ABBREVIATION:
アポ is short for アポイントメント (appointment). Very common in business Japanese.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・アポを{取|と}る (to get/make an appointment)
・アポを{入|い}れる (to schedule an appointment)
・アポがある (to have an appointment)
・アポなし (without an appointment)

BUSINESS CONTEXT:
・{飛|と}び{込|こ}み{営業|えいぎょう} vs アポ{営業|えいぎょう}
  (cold-calling sales vs appointment-based sales)
・アポなし{訪問|ほうもん} (unannounced visit - generally considered rude in Japanese business culture)

REGISTER:
Casual business slang. In formal writing, use:
・{約束|やくそく} (appointment, promise)
・{面会|めんかい}の{予約|よやく} (reservation for a meeting)
・{訪問|ほうもん}の{予定|よてい} (scheduled visit)

SIMILAR ABBREVIATIONS:
・リスケ (reschedule ← リスケジュール)
・プレゼン (presentation ← プレゼンテーション)
